instruction: Locate a men's short sleeve polo shirt in medium size and solid color that's available at a sale price.

metadata.explanation: Variation 0: Changed from stripe patterned T-shirt (large) to solid color polo shirt (medium). Maintains same structure: men's clothing, shirts category, size filter, 50% off discount filter, and short sleeves. Uses existing get_url_path_parse and check_direct_json_object functions. The evaluator parses the Macy's product URL to verify the agent navigated to the correct filtered product page.
metadata.similarity_notes: Very similar to original - same website, same number of filters, same interaction pattern (search + filter navigation), only differs in specific product attributes (polo vs T-shirt, M vs L size)
